title: Wall signs, stair side.
officialText:
In high-rise buildings subject to Section 403, signs shall be posted and maintained on the wall as follows:
1. Reentry. Where a reentry door is recessed, a supplementary sign complying with Section 1030.4.3, except that the lettering and numerals shall be at least 1 inch (25 mm) high, shall be securely attached on the wall of the landing and shall be readily visible to the evacuee on the stairs indicating the location of such recessed reentry door.
2. No reentry. Where there is no reentry from the stair, an additional sign complying with Subdivision 2 of Sections 1030.4.2 and 1030.4.3, except that the lettering and numerals shall be at least 1 inch (25 mm) high, shall be securely attached at the beginning of the descent into such portion of the stair on the wall of the landing and shall be readily visible to the evacuee on the stairs.
